_note: Book title colour = its cover colour (the FHB edition-page method, FHB src/data/cover-colors.json _note, Kevin 2026-11-14 '1A'). MEASURED from the book's cover image (PIL median-cut, 8 colours, share of the cover face). title = the dominant cover colour when it passes WCAG AA 4.5:1 on white (order box) AND on the page's stone-50 #faf8f5 (hero); else deepened (HLS lightness, <=0.15) when the hue stays recognisable; else the true colour with a thin dark outline (W3C G18), outline: true. No entry = ink. Re-measure when a cover changes.
